description: This Java class 'DatabaseUpdaterLiquibaseProvider' implements the 'LiquibaseProvider' interface, acting as a wrapper around 'DatabaseUpdater.getLiquibase(String)', facilitating dependency injection for Liquibase operations within the OpenMRS codebase.

classes.name: DatabaseUpdaterLiquibaseProvider
classes.description: Provides a wrapper for the DatabaseUpdater's getLiquibase method, implementing the LiquibaseProvider interface for dependency injection and easier testing.

methods.name: getLiquibase
methods.description: Returns a Liquibase instance by delegating to DatabaseUpdater.getLiquibase, given a changelog file path.
